title: Login with username and password
steps: Enter username and password, press Login
expected: Signed in and taken to the Home page

title: Login rejected with blank password
steps: Enter username, leave password blank, press Login
expected: Stay on login page with an error message

title: Protected page requires sign-in
steps: Open /products without signing in

title: Password is masked
steps: Open login page, inspect password field

title: Home page shows business summary + promo video
steps: Open Home
expected: 8 items, 3 low, 1 out, 6 invoices, $803.50 total sales; video present

title: Stock list shows all items with key fields
steps: Open Stock
expected: All 8 items listed with SKU, name, price, qty and status badge
actual: 8 of 8 SKUs listed; badges: In/Low/Out present = true

title: Search stock
steps: Type "webcam" in search, press Search

title: Add a new stock item
steps: Stock > Add item, fill the form, Save
expected: Item saved and its detail page shown

title: Add item with no name is rejected (server)
steps: Submit the add form with name and brand empty
expected: Not saved; error "needs at least a product name and a brand"

title: Add form validates before sending (client)
steps: Open Add item, press Save with empty fields
expected: Form not submitted; browser shows "fill out this field"
actual: stayed on form = true; message = "Please fill out this field."

title: Edit a stock item and save
steps: Open item > Edit, change price, Save

title: Disable a stock item
steps: Edit item, set status Disabled, Save

title: Stock adjustment - add
steps: Item WM-200 > Add stock 5, reason "Restocked", Submit
expected: On hand becomes 12; adjustment appears in audit history
actual: on hand 12; ledger entry by jsmith = false

title: Stock can never go negative
steps: Item LPA-008 (on hand 2) > Remove 50

title: Stock reconcile to a counted total
steps: Item LPA-008 > Reconcile to 10

title: Delete a stock item
steps: Open LPA-009 > Delete > confirm
expected: Item removed; opening it again returns Not found (404)

title: Sales & Invoicing lists invoices with total
steps: Open Sales
expected: 6 invoices with Date, Client, Amount; Total $803.50
actual: 6 invoices; headers Date/Client/Amount = true; total $803.50 = true

title: Search invoices by client
steps: Type "DevWorks" in search, press Search

title: Client records with address; search
steps: Open Clients; search "Northgate"

title: Every invoice points to an existing client
steps: Check each invoice clientId against the client list
actual: 6 of 6 invoices have no valid client ID

title: Stock available as JSON (API)
steps: GET /products with Accept: application/json

title: Logout ends the session
steps: Press Logout, then try to open Stock
expected: Sent back to the login page

title: Theme preference is remembered
steps: Settings > choose Dark, then open Home

title: Mashup pages open
steps: Open Mashups > Store locator and Pricing

title: Home page response time
steps: Request Home 5 times, average the time

title: Audit history records who and when
steps: After UC-12, open Stock > Audit history
expected: Newest entry shows user jsmith and a time
actual: user jsmith shown = false; time shown = false

title: Mobile app opens the LPA interface
steps: Install APK on Pixel 7 emulator, open LPA eComms
expected: Splash screen for ~2 s, then login page inside the app
actual: Static check passed (APK launch activity = SplashActivity; INTERNET permission). On-device run to be recorded.
